note: Chapter XVII full pass in the Book I painting style (Ian, 17 Nov), shot-sized.
style: A cinematic Romantic oil painting of 1893 in the exact manner of the reference painting: academic realism with dramatic chiaroscuro, cool blue dusk and moonlight against warm amber lamplight, atmospheric haze and shafts of light, deep architectural space, rich painterly brushwork. One single painting filling the whole 16:9 frame, no text, signature, border or black bars.

beats.text: Shot: establishing, far. Late stormy afternoon: a closed carriage halts before the tall iron gates of a lunatic asylum in the Essex marshes; high black wall, grim building with barred windows beyond, bare trees bending in the wind, a bruised sky with a last band of cold light.

Shot: looking in from outside, far. From the dusk garden, looking in through a tall lit study window of the asylum: a doctor and a young woman by a phonograph inside, small; ivy, brick, elms against a fading blue sky.
Shot: looking in from outside, far. The long dark front of the asylum at night seen across the lawn, one window lit gold where a small figure sits; moon in thin cloud, chimneys, black trees.
Shot: wide. At dusk the doctor stands at an upstairs window of the asylum, seen from behind, looking out over a high wall at the neighbouring gloomy old house among trees.

Shot: establishing, far. Carfax at dusk across the high wall: a huge gloomy half-ruined stone mansion with barred high windows and an old chapel joined to it, dark trees, a weedy pond, ravens, cold blue sky.
Shot: wide. Inside the ruined chapel of Carfax at night: about fifty great wooden boxes of earth stacked in dust and cobwebs, a shaft of cold moonlight from a broken window. No people.
Shot: establishing, far. Evening: a hansom cab at the lit doorway of the asylum, two tall men stepping down, gold lamplight on the gravel, deep blue sky above dark elms.
Shot: wide, far. A long asylum corridor in red evening light, rows of tall windows; a tall lean man in a travelling coat stands far off at a window, looking out.
Shot: establishing, far. The asylum at night from the garden, a few windows lit gold, moon behind thin cloud, and beyond the wall the black shape of Carfax among trees.
